scope: Documentation facts for explicit metric applicability/disposition assessment against the actual app source. This is not an instrumented receipt, precomputed fixture applicability or a requirement to emit every optional instrument. It does not change the shared GenAI profile or capture provenance.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.client.inference.duration
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Actual client inference attempt duration, including errors; not agent or tool duration.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.client.inference.time_to_first_chunk
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Client streaming response first-chunk timing; requires an actual stream.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.client.inference.time_per_output_chunk
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Client streaming inter-chunk timing; requires subsequent response chunks.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.client.inference.usage.input_tokens
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Monotonic input-usage total; observed count or specified missing-response zero with unknown modality.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.client.inference.usage.output_tokens
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Monotonic output-usage total; observed count or specified missing-response zero with unknown modality.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.client.inference.usage.cache_read.input_tokens
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Known cache-read subset of input usage; no invented cache breakdown.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.client.inference.usage.cache_write.input_tokens
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Known cache-write subset of input usage; no invented cache breakdown.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.client.inference.usage.reasoning.output_tokens
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Known reasoning subset of output usage; no invented reasoning breakdown.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.client.inference.operation.input_tokens
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Per-inference input-token distribution, not total usage; no modality dimension; documented missing-usage zero.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.client.inference.operation.output_tokens
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Per-inference output-token distribution, not total usage; no modality dimension; documented missing-usage zero.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.client.operation.duration
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Assess non-inference GenAI operation scope; inference is explicitly excluded.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.server.request.duration
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Model-server request duration; requires observation of server execution, distinct from client latency.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.server.time_per_output_token
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Model-server token-generation timing; requires server-side observations.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.server.time_to_first_token
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Model-server first-token timing; requires server-side observations.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.invoke_workflow.duration
metric_facts.scope_conditions: A distinct bounded workflow execution; do not invent another boundary for a single agent.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Reliably bounded in-process agent invocation, including terminal errors.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.invoke_agent.inference_calls
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Inference attempts attributed once to their issuing agent invocation, including failed attempts.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.invoke_agent.tool_calls
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Agent-side tool attempts attributed once to their issuing agent invocation, including failed attempts.

metric_facts.name: gen_ai.execute_tool.duration
metric_facts.scope_conditions: Reliably bounded observable tool execution, matching its span duration when both are reported.

audit_requirement: For each listed metric, decide source boundary/value availability, applicability and reason, and required/recommended/optional/deferred/covered disposition using actual app source and current skill/vendor/user acceptance. Unknown source facts stay unknown. Core required metrics remain executable findings; optional omission needs an explicit decision, not a false covered claim.
